reviews.text: Over-the-top experience from start to finish! Holly was amazing at addressing my concerns, understanding my needs, and getting my appointment scheduled quickly. Andrew walked me through the diagnostics and required repairs on my equipment in a clear, transparent way that was easy to understand. I honestly expected the cost to be much higher and was pleasantly surprised it was far less than anticipated. If you need anything "pool" related, I highly recommend this company—hands down. I’m officiall

Absolutely fantastic experience with Safari Pool Services! They’ve been taking care of our pool for a while now, and I can’t say enough about how professional, reliable, and thorough they are. Every visit, they go above and beyond to keep everything sparkling clean and running smoothly. If you’re looking for a team that treats your pool like their own little paradise, these are your go-to folks. Five stars all the way!

We’ve tried several pool services over the years, and Safari Pool Service is by far the best. Their team is reliable, professional, and does an excellent job keeping our pool sparkling clean. They’re proactive with maintenance, quick to respond to any issues, and always a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-notch pool service!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Pool Heater Service!
I couldn’t be happier with the service I received on my pool heater. The technician was professional, knowledgeable, and arrived right on time. Andrew quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and had the heater running perfectly in no time. The water is heating better than ever! Great communication, fair pricing, and outstanding customer service — highly recommend to anyone needing pool equipment repairs or maintenance.

It’s been 3 weeks of using Safari, and the difference in quality of cleaning and service is night and day better compared to the company I used for years.

I sort of put the previous company on auto pilot and never checked, but now after seeing Safari’s level of cleaning, I realized Safari just does a better job and their team cares.

Love Safari Pool Service. All of their employees are very professional and easy to work with. Our pool is always clear and clean. I appreciate all of the pictures that they send me after servicing our pool.

We have had multiple pool services throughout the years but Safari Pool Services surpasses them all by a long shot!!
They go out their way to pursue excellence and individualizing their clients. I cannot say enough about the hard work to provide custom care.

Safari Pools has been out standing to work with, Andrew is an amazing pool expert...his knowledge and kindness in how he handled our pool and cleaning the spa and educating us was amazing that our previous pool company never brought to our attention before...i would recommend Safari.
We are very pleased with the service provided by Safari Pools! They were quick to respond and solved our issue. Will definitely use again and highly recommend.
Frank and Holly @ Safari Pools took great care of us!!! They were quick to respond and offered great service!! Friendly and knowledgeable people at Safari Pool Service!! I’ll call them every time!!
My pool has never looked better with the services from Safari Pool. They do an excellent job and keep me informed of their activities and any issues that they uncover. Highly recommend!
Safari Pools has been great!!  They are very responsive, thorough and client focused.
Andrew came to diagnose a problem with to the spa heater. He was excellent to work with. Safari pools is top notch and right in Grapevine.

Reliable service and trustworthy people.  They’ve taken care of our pool since we built it a few years ago.  Accessible and quick responding personnel.  Reasonably, competitively priced.  We appreciate Safari Pools!
Safari Pools has a wonderful team of people. Great communicators.Tony does a very thorough job each week of cleaning our pool and keeping our pool chemically balanced.
We had a new pool filter installed. Quick service and great pricing… highly recommend!

Safari Pool Renovations exceeded our expectations! Their team of experts transformed our outdated pool into a stunning oasis. The water features are breathtaking, and the pool lighting is fantastic. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and commitment to quality are impressive. Our pool is now the envy of the neighborhood! 5 stars and highly recommended!"

Safari is doing a complete remodel of my pool, which was vintage 1994. Their suggestions for materials, design, were excellent. They helped us choose colors and patterns that are a real improvement of our original choices.  The work has been excellent and the crews very efficient.  I will be posting pictures when the work is completed.

Safari Pool Renovations is an excellent company with even better customer service. They pay attention to detail as well as providing quality materials without breaking your budget. If looking for a pool renovation service look no further!
I’ve been using this company for years. I went through a lot of different pool companies and this one is hands down, the best! Don’t hesitate to use them!

data.summary: The reviews are overwhelmingly positive and contain authentic-seeming details like specific employee names and services. However, the complete lack of any critical feedback, the anonymity of all reviewers, and the perfect 5.0 score from 20 reviews on Google raise mild concerns about review curation or a lack of balanced feedback. There is no evidence of fake review patterns like same-day posting, but the profile is suspiciously pristine.
fake_signals: High proportion of generic, effusive praise
No negative or critical reviews present
authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Holly, Andrew, Frank)
Mentions of specific services (pool heater repair, diagnostics, cleaning)
Varied project details (maintenance, repairs, switching from another service)
Mentions of communication practices (pictures sent after service)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only significant rating source is Google, which shows a perfect 5.0. No contradictory ratings from other major platforms were found.
